# Nested lists

## Description

Two-space nesting:

- Check one
  - Pass: first
  - Fail: second
- Check two

Four-space nesting:

- Check one
    - Pass: first
    - Fail: second
- Check two

Ordered, four spaces:

1. Step
    1. Inner step
    2. Inner step two
2. Step two
